description: AC2 instruction scenarios; live T3 exercise is recorded separately at the migration gate. T3/T4 append hygiene and watch cases.

cases.input: t3_thread_launch returned no response; one thread with the exact dispatch title appears after pagination and its worktree agrees.

expected.action: Adopt the one exact match; keep its reserved branch. Relaunch once only on proven absence; multiple matches or incomplete inventory hold.

cases.input: Launch returned preparing and no notification; the 120000ms post-launch wait reports failed during worktree provisioning.

expected.action: Record launch failure, never completed. A timeout with activeRunId and worktreePath proves started; still preparing holds until the next wake.

cases.input: A started writer dies without sending a receipt after the driver ends its turn; the bound 600000ms watch wakes the driver.

expected.action: Reconcile the failed run and hold incomplete; replace only after terminal failure with a<n+1>, retaining the failed branch for salvage.

cases.input: AXSTACK-DONE arrives for a1 at an old candidate SHA while a2 is the current attempt.

expected.action: Keep a2 unsettled; the old receipt is evidence only. Persist task_status before thread reads and require terminal state at the current attempt and SHA.

cases.input: task_status is completed with AXSTACK-QUESTION; after an answer the original summary remains unchanged and no resumed-run notification arrives.

expected.action: Answer once via t3_thread_send to childThreadId, wait 600000ms on the resumed run with watch rearming, and accept only latestTerminal* newer than the question run.
